column1: # Source-pool admissions: crown candidates added by hand, one per line,
# as word, reason.
# Why this file exists. When a crown is retired for register, its
# replacement cannot come from source-exclusions.tsv: every word in
# that cull violates one of the three rules by construction, and a
# plural has no etymology of its own to reveal, which is the whole
# point of the crown. So the source pool is widened instead, by the
# minimum needed, and each admission is recorded here.
# What an admission must satisfy, all enforced by
# scripts/admit-source-words.ts, which refuses to write otherwise:
#   exactly 8 letters
#   in the common pool, so inside the SOURCE_POOL_SIZES bands (10, 20)
#   in the validation boundary and not denied
#   a clean base word: not a pure inflection, a degree form, or a
#     past-tense dual, the three Phase 2 cull rules
#   carries BOTH a definition and an etymology, since REQUIRE_ETYMOLOGY
#     is what makes the reveal work
#   clears MIN_SET_SIZE through createPuzzle
# These three were already in the common pool at the right band and
# were only missing from the source pool because their cached
# Wiktionary etymology was a throttled null. Re-fetching returns a
# full etymology for each. See the note on enrichWord in
# scripts/lib/wiktionary.ts: the same cache issue is why roughly 868
# eligible 8-letter common words never entered the pool, which is a
# larger decision than this change.
